items.t: NIO Is Down 26% in 3 Months. Is It Time to Sell, or Load Up?
items.sum: Key TakeawaysNIO delivered 34,246 vehicles in October, down from 37,408 in September and about 15% below October 2025. Hitting its goal of more than 40,000 monthly deliveries in the fourth quarter now requires roughly 43,000 a month in November and December.
